title: EviDraft platform-neutral command/agent/skill/hook
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of every markdown file in plugins/scholar-ip/{commands,agents,skills,hooks}.

slash.description: Slash-command form (commands only). Either bare `/cmd` or plugin-namespaced `/plugin:cmd`.

primary_deliverable.description: Legacy v1 marker for the primary deliverable of a phase.

retention.description: Declarative disk-retention policy for accumulating-output commands (e.g. xreview, polish). v0.1 ships the declaration only — adapters enforce in v0.2 by emitting a pre-command pruning step. Until then this block is informational.

keep_last.description: Maximum number of output files to retain. Older files pruned at next invocation (v0.2).

max_age_days.description: Maximum age in days of any retained output file (v0.2).

model.description: agents only — pin the subagent to a specific Claude model tier (haiku/sonnet/opus) or `inherit` from the session. Maps to the Claude Code agent frontmatter `model:` field; ignored by adapters that have no equivalent.

effort.description: agents only — reasoning-effort hint for the dispatched subagent. Maps to the Claude Code agent frontmatter `effort:` field; ignored by adapters that have no equivalent.

executable_script.description: hooks only: filename (relative to plugins/scholar-ip/hooks/) of a bash script the claude_code adapter copies into the rendered plugin and references from hooks/hooks.json. Hooks without this field remain advisory text.

cc_event.description: hooks only: explicit Claude Code event name used by the adapter to derive hooks.json. Overrides any event inferred from `triggers` (which then survives only as advisory text in the codex_cli adapter).

cc_matcher.description: hooks only: optional Claude Code tool-name matcher (regex) paired with cc_event.
